I didn't play the start of TWW as i was finishing my school but finished early into prog where i joined <Now Watch This Drive> - Area52 as a Evoker mid Broodtwister prog. After killing Ansurek I had the chance to trial with some top 50 US guilds however was going to trial with <Fun Detected> however there was christmas break and after taking a few weeks off from raiding i ended up finding a job that clashed with raid times so i took a break from the game. Shortly before LoU i left that job and had time to raid and re-joined <Serious Face> - Illidan for LoU where i played Shadow priest early on but swapped to rogue due to the rogue trial failing the trial. 

As for why i'm looking for a new guild after this tier. I want to push myself, I want to improve as a player and push to get HoF. I feel like i have more to learn and improve as a player and the best way to do that is be surrounded by better players that push you to be constantly improving. I love my guild and friends in the guild however the guild leadership are all entering parenthood and this is likely to be the last tier where the guild is going to continue raiding at this level, I'm finally in a place where my schedule is set and I don't have questions about my availability due to school / work.

I've been raiding competitively with multiple top US finishes since the beginning of MoP. I raided with a few guilds, but one of the most notable guilds during that time would be Arathian Knights, where I helped build and run the guild for sever tiers throughout Legion and into BFA, culminating in a US 7 finish in BoD. During this time I played several characters, including tanking for two tiers. Most of the time I played range DPS so I could also raid lead.

My most notable guild history would be my time with BDG, or Big Dumb Gaming. I joined BDG during farm after BoD/Crucible playing Warlock. I raided with them consistently as we got more competitive and became an officer after Nyalotha progression. During these tiers we were consistently US 2, hovering between World 4-9. 

After Castle Nathria in an effort to be more competitive as a guild, I stepped out of the raid to become the 21st man raid leader. I raid lead for BDG the following several tiers, finally retiring after Vault of the Incarnates in Dragonflight. 

I took a break from the game for the remainder of Dragonflight due to burnout. I finally returned at the launch of the War Within to play a bit more casually, and created a 2-day raiding guild with some friends. We started the guild a month into NP just pugging and finding people slowly, but managed to scrape out CE. This tier we finished at ~US 250 while raiding 6 hours a week. I did 90%+ of the out of raid work for progression including preparing for fights, recruiting, tweaking strats, making comps, and some raid leading. The guild finally died after the person I created the guild with, Veyloris, opted to retire to focus on his job. I thought about continuing to keep the guild going, but was not interested in doing so on my own.
